BL-1707 — Swarm stamp-off: hotfixes 22a2a9fc7f, 7ba57573ff and e94b78a7a3 - the in-process-resume STOP banner no longer tells an aider seat to run the script it forbids, the local compliance battery gains the coder-stop_banner_compliance safety competency (a coder-tool_capability_denial added alongside it was withdrawn the same evening) and survives a timed-out probe - review-only certification (BL-848) of what landed on 2026-09-23
What it solves: ## What
Three operator hotfixes from 2026-09-23, live on main, never through a
gate. This is that gate: a REVIEW ticket - confirm or refute, open
narrow follow-ups for anything found.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed. What needs sign-off is the DISPOSITION only - one review ticket for three same-day hotfixes that share one subject (the STOP banner and the competency that probes it; the withdrawn competency's add and removal are one net c…
BL-1707 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1707" (or "reject BL-1707 <reason>") to act.
